scripts.build: cross-env VITE_DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL=master yarn workspaces foreach --all --topological-dev run build
scripts.compile: yarn build && cross-env VITE_DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL=master electron-builder build --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.compile:stable: yarn build:stable && cross-env VITE_DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL=stable electron-builder build --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.compile:beta: yarn build:beta && cross-env VITE_DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL=beta electron-builder build --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.init: yarn create-renderer && yarn integrate-renderer && yarn install
